newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures edge off late, most end down.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures edge off late, most end down.

text.p: Dec 24 - IMM currency futures edged off again late, most end dull trade lower. Futures closed early at 1200 CST/1800 GMT, stay shut Wednesday. March Swiss francs fell to new contract at $0.7476 on what some traders viewed as yearend liquidation.
March yen challenged support near $0.008840, or 114.50 spot, but lacked followthrough. Contract low seen soon at $0.008835.
